/-!
# Mathoverflow 31809

Source:
[Mathoverflow/31809](https://mathoverflow.net/questions/31809/pre-triangulated-category-that-isnt-triangulated)

-/

namespace Mathoverflow31809

open CategoryTheory Limits Category Preadditive Pretriangulated

/-- Does there exist a category that is pretriangulated but not triangulated? -/
@[category research open, AMS 18]
theorem mathoverflow_31809 : answer(sorry) ↔ (∀ (C : Type*) [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [∀ (n : ℤ), (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C], IsTriangulated C) := by
  sorry

end Mathoverflow31809

findings.description: The right-hand side at lines 33–35 says that every pretriangulated category is triangulated. This is the negation of the source's existence question, not an equivalent positive formulation: answer(True) would mean that no requested counterexample exists, while answer(False) would mean that one exists. In the scratch file, I proved that existence of a category and the listed structure instances with ¬ IsTriangulated C is equivalent to the negation of the current universal right-hand side.
findings.source_evidence: MathOverflow 31809 opens by asking about a pretriangulated category that is not triangulated. Part 2 explicitly asks: “what is an example of a pre-triangulated category that is not a triangulated category?” https://mathoverflow.net/questions/31809/pre-triangulated-category-that-isnt-triangulated
findings.suggested_fix: Negate the entire current parenthesized universal right-hand side, leaving the answer slot and all binders unchanged. Thus use `answer(sorry) ↔ ¬ (∀ (C : Type*) [Category C] [Preadditive C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C], IsTriangulated C)`. Equivalently, existentially quantify C and these structure instances and conclude `¬ IsTriangulated C`. Apply the separate status/answer update below after this correction.

status_issues.source_status: The MathOverflow answer dated 11 August 2026 reports a counterexample, citing Chen–Liu–Lu–Zhang, arXiv:2608.09777v1 (submitted 10 August 2026). Theorem 1.2 constructs a pretriangulated structure on finitely generated projective modules over the type-A₅ preprojective algebra over 𝔽₂ that is not triangulated. This answers the original existence question affirmatively and the file's complementary universal question negatively.
status_issues.evidence: https://mathoverflow.net/questions/31809/pre-triangulated-category-that-isnt-triangulated#514138 says the linked paper “constructs a pre-triangulated category which is not triangulated.” The abstract and Theorem 1.2 of https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09777 state that result. The older contrary claim in arXiv:1506.00887 is explicitly withdrawn.
status_issues.suggested_change: Change the category to `research solved` and cite Chen–Liu–Lu–Zhang. After correcting the right-hand side to express existence as described in the finding, replace the answer slot with `answer(True)`.

reformulations.difference: The sources assume an additive category, whereas the Lean hypotheses explicitly name Preadditive C and HasZeroObject C without separately requiring finite biproducts.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: This aspect of the hypothesis list is equivalent, not a missing assumption. Mathlib derives HasBinaryBiproducts C and HasFiniteBiproducts C from the other pretriangulated-category hypotheses (Pretriangulated.lean, lines 562–576). Adding HasFiniteBiproducts therefore does not change the allowed structures. The scratch file proves that the universal proposition is equivalent to the same proposition with that additional hypothesis. This equivalence concerns the category assumptions only; it does not repair the separate answer-polarity defect.

review.notes: All scratch checks are in /workspace/review/scratch.lean and compile without errors or warnings. The key logical equivalences have no sorryAx dependency. Boundary checks exclude an empty category via HasZeroObject, show the distinguished class cannot be empty, and construct the one-object, one-morphism zero category satisfying the hypotheses and conclusion. A homotopy category of ℤ-modules also instantiates the hypotheses. The status assessment follows the current source and linked paper; it is not an independent verification of the entire counterexample proof.

not_demonstrated.reason: Reversing the answer polarity does not make the universal statement trivially provable or refutable. Refuting it requires a substantive construction of a pretriangulated category that fails the octahedral axiom; proving that the source's existence question is its logical negation does not prove or disprove the declaration itself.

submission.summary: No trivial-proof file was created, and no compilation was attempted.
submission.gave_up_reason: The sole finding is a polarity mismatch, not trivial solvability. I have no short, honest proof or disproof of the exact declaration, and the logical complement lemma from the review is not a demonstration of the kind requested.

submission.summary: Negated the universal right-hand side so a positive answer asserts existence of a pretriangulated category that is not triangulated. Applied the separate status update to `research solved` and `answer(True)`, with a citation to Chen–Liu–Lu–Zhang, Theorem 1.2. The required compilation succeeds with only the expected `sorry` warning; only the authorized problem file was edited.

/-!
# Mathoverflow 31809

Sources:
* [Mathoverflow/31809](https://mathoverflow.net/questions/31809/pre-triangulated-category-that-isnt-triangulated)
* [CLLZ26] X.-W. Chen, J. Liu, X.-S. Lu and C. Zhang,

namespace Mathoverflow31809

open CategoryTheory Limits Category Preadditive Pretriangulated

/-- Does there exist a category that is pretriangulated but not triangulated?

Chen, Liu, Lu and Zhang constructed such a category in [CLLZ26, Theorem 1.2]. -/
@[category research solved, AMS 18]
theorem mathoverflow_31809 : answer(True) ↔ ¬ (∀ (C : Type*) [Category C] [Preadditive C]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [∀ (n : ℤ), (shiftFunctor C n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated C], IsTriangulated C) := by
  sorry

end Mathoverflow31809
